apiToken.description: Okta API token for SSWS (token-based) authentication. Required when clientId+privateKey are not provided. Mutually exclusive with clientId+privateKey.

clientId.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID for private-key (OAuth) authentication. Required together with privateKey when apiToken is not provided.

privateKey.description: PEM-encoded RSA private key for private-key (OAuth) authentication. Required together with clientId when apiToken is not provided.

scopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes; defaults to okta.users.manage, okta.groups.manage, okta.apps.manage when using private-key auth

config.constraints: Credentials are conditionally required: either apiToken OR (clientId AND privateKey) must be provided at runtime.

email.description: User email address (required when profile is absent)
